label: PRIMERGY RX1330 M5 1U server
description: Mono-socket 1U rack server: two gigabit RJ45 data ports on the Intel i210 controller plus a dedicated gigabit management port for the iRMC S6, three PCIe slots (two Gen4, one Gen3) and up to 4x 3.5-inch or 10x 2.5-inch drives.
notes: Fujitsu data sheet: 'LAN Controller: Intel i210 onboard, 2 x 10/100/1000 Mbit/s Ethernet (TCP/IP acceleration)', 'Management LAN: 1 x dedicated management LAN port for iRMC S6 (10/100/1000 Mbit/s)'. Both facts are quoted because the dedicated port is easy to miss and it is the one you cable to a separate OOB switch - which is exactly the lab this model exists for. The data sheet also notes management LAN traffic can be switched to a shared onboard port, which is a configuration choice, not a second port. Xeon E-2300, 4 DIMMs to 128 GB, integrated RAID 0/1 (RAID 5/6 optional), short-depth chassis variant available. The 2x Gbit LAN is the onboard figure; any extra ports come from optional LAN cards in the PCIe slots and are deliberately not modelled.
